ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized along the trailing edges and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous white field across both lobes. Distinct dark pigmented regions along the posterior-lateral margin of the right lobe. Brown/tan textured macro-clusters at distal tips. Scattered small dark focal spots distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 45-degree V-shaped depression; the vertex point is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/pixels at the center base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularities along the right lobe trailing edge. Left lobe displays moderate-frequency serrations becoming more pronounced towards the tip. Significant non-biological pixel clusters (barnacles) disrupt the natural linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a shallow convex trajectory terminating in an acute tip. Right lobe displays a more rounded, convex curve significantly modified by external biological growth.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of dark, circular pixel clusters (scars/spots) scattered across the white ventral surface. Massive high-relief brown/orange clusters (live barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) primarily on the right lobe, including three prominent near-vertical parallel lines and several intersecting diagonal marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on the distal tips and trailing edges, creating significant textural and color deviations from the fluke surface. Extensive linear rake marks across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The volume of barnacle encrustation on the tips is exceptionally high, creating a 'pom-pom' effect that obscures the natural geometric tips of the fluke.
